description: Measures GPU kernel launch overhead with an empty kernel (no work), so the time is pure dispatch / grid-scheduling / completion cost. Sweeping num_blocks shows how overhead grows with grid size; block_size is swept as a non-scaling parameter. Reports launch_sync_us (round-trip launch+synchronize per launch) and enqueue_us (back-to-back async dispatch per launch).

scaling_param.name: num_blocks
scaling_param.description: Number of thread blocks in the (empty) grid; primary axis for launch/scheduling overhead

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block in the empty grid
